text:
camille: quick favor — can someone run a microbench for valkyrie-13b using the new int4+fp8 fallback profile? i'm seeing a p99 tail spike on longer contexts and want concrete numbers vs int8 baseline.

devin: on it. do you want 2k and 8k context distributions? any specific prompt set?

camille: both 2k and 8k but focus on 8k tail. use warmup=10 iters, batch=1. capture p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, and kernel timeline.

devin: ack. i'll run on canary A100 if available. command i'll use:```
./perf/run_microbench.sh --model valkyrie-13b --profile=int4_fp8_fallback --seq_len=8192 --batch=1 --warmup=10 --iters=200 --log=artifacts/microbench-186789.json
```

priya: cc @andre — if this changes the hot path we need a short canary plan. also FYI results on T4 will look different.

andre: i'll reserve an A100 slot at 14:30 PT for a 6h canary window. devin, tag perf-bot so we get the standardized summary.

perf-bot: queued job 6582 for valkyrie-13b int4_fp8_fallback on a100-canary-01. will post summary when complete.

devin: pushed a tiny PR that toggles the fallback path and exposes REDWOOD_QUANT_FALLBACK env var — https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3921 (ping for quick CR).

priya: looking at the PR now. heads-up: the fallback path currently does an extra memcpy inside the attention loop which could add latency on long sequences. maybe we can move the memcpy to prefetch step.

camille: tradeoff note — earlier evaluations showed fallback reduced hallucination rate by ~0.8% on our long-seq eval set. if p99 increase is small (<10%) the quality improvement might be worth it. need numbers.

andre: agreed. run A/B: int4+fallback vs int8 baseline. use eval set qa/long_seq_500 (500 prompts). measure P0 token-error and exact-match-ish heuristics. include nvidia-smi snapshots and kernel traces.

perf-bot: job 6582 completed. summary: variant=int4_fp8_fallback p50=20ms p95=260ms p99=470ms tps=188; quality_delta: halluc_rate_down=0.9% vs baseline. logs at s3://redwood-artifacts/microbench/6582/summary.txt

perf-bot: job 6583 completed (int8 baseline). summary: variant=int8 p50=17ms p95=230ms p99=440ms tps=205; quality baseline metrics in s3://redwood-artifacts/microbench/6583/summary.txt

devin: raw numbers attached above. int4+fallback reduces hallucination ~0.9% but increases p99 by ~30ms (≈7% relative). kernel traces show extra memcpy + cache-resync at step ~5120.

priya: thanks — that's within the 10% threshold. i'll open a tracking ticket for optimizing the memcpy position and a follow-up perf patch.

camille: plan: 6h canary on a100-canary-01 with REDWOOD_QUANT_FALLBACK=1, monitor p99 and user-facing error rate. rollback if p99 > baseline by >10% or if quality regresses on production prompts. @andre please start the canary at 14:30 PT.

andre: starting canary now. will post updates. :rocket: 

devin: PR link again for reviewers: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3921 — small change, tests included. ping me for quick CR.

priya: reviewed + left one comment about moving memcpy. will approve after that tweak.

camille: awesome, thanks team. will follow up with a short writeup for the next eng-runtime sync.
